execution.description: First build of the miner's research surface (C-MLP-05): a Challenge-neutral research-view declaration, the battery adapter, one allow-listed campaign view and carbon_note as operations in the shared table, attach bringing the research prompts and skill, the branded page and a synthetic demo campaign.

expected: Battery's practice components and public practice curves draw through a declaration any Challenge can supply, and per-case detail is allowed only if a recorded rule allows it.
observed: The declaration covers battery from what it already publishes: objective outputs, exam components, the practice disclosure contract and the feedback ladder. A synthetic second Challenge draws every output kind through the same code. The per-case question was settled by the practice population's own disclosure contract (public_practice_labels public, aggregation detailed_own_public_practice); the dropped _rows had no recorded reason. A battery learning curve cannot be added without changing the staged worker program, so it is an owner question (RSURF-D3). Two tooling faults showed up: the editing tool decoded \u escapes written into source into literal invisible characters (bidirectional overrides in a regex, a byte-order mark in a test), caught only by ruff's PLE2502; and canonical pytest needs CARBON_UV_GROUPS for the MCP and chain suites, without which collection fails on a missing cryptography import.
keep: Ask the Challenge, through its registered campaign, for anything a door would otherwise hard-code: outputs, components, disclosure, feedback fields.
Settle a disclosure question from the authored disclosure contract, and make the code read the same contract, so the rule and the behaviour cannot drift.
Put new operations in the shared table, so the browser route and the MCP tool are one generated thing and parity is structural.
Keep a renderer's layout pure so Node can test it without a browser.
change: Write escape sequences into source as double-escaped text, then scan new files for invisible characters before committing.
Set CARBON_UV_GROUPS (science-jax chain mcp) for canonical runs of Launchpad and MCP suites.
